title: Mock Draft and Live Draft
description: Preserves pick order, available alternatives, decision logic, team need, market behavior and format context.
principles: Preserve draft order and format context before interpreting individual picks.
Record alternatives and reasoning when the source discusses them.
Distinguish source preference from observed market behavior and team need.
Do not silently stop after the headline ranking segment.

dimensions.description: League size, quarterback settings, scoring and draft type.
dimensions.preservation_expectation: Preserve all context needed to interpret pick value.
detection_questions: What draft format controls the board?

dimensions.preservation_expectation: Retain pick number, selected subject and order.
detection_questions: Can the draft be replayed from the extraction?

dimensions.preservation_expectation: Preserve meaningful alternatives and the reason they lost.
Keep talent, need, scarcity, stack, price or strategy reasoning.
Retain when need affects selection, but distinguish it from pure value.
detection_questions: Did need cause a reach or break a tie?

dimensions.description: Observed market pressure and positional runs.
dimensions.preservation_expectation: Preserve how scarcity changes actual draft behavior.
detection_questions: Was a player pushed up or down by market dynamics?

dimensions.description: Source judgments on reaches, values and falls.
detection_questions: Why is a pick early or late?

dimensions.preservation_expectation: Preserve disagreement and alternate draft paths.

dimensions.description: What later availability teaches about strategy.
dimensions.preservation_expectation: Retain source conclusions about waiting, positional depth and construction.
detection_questions: What did later rounds confirm or contradict?

passing: Preserve the reference only where it is needed to understand another argument.
Do not create an artificial standalone evaluation.
brief: Preserve the conclusion and its immediate qualifier or condition.
Do not expand beyond what the source supports.
substantive: Preserve the conclusion plus the meaningful reason, condition, risk or uncertainty supplied by the source.
Keep format, price or time-horizon distinctions when they materially change the view.
deep: Preserve the complete major reasoning chain rather than only the final verdict.
Represent every materially discussed dimension, including competing positive and negative cases.
Keep disagreements, uncertainty, conditions and failure paths.
structural: Preserve the broad thesis, its mechanism, its scope and the subjects it affects.
Create independently reusable context takes rather than burying the thesis inside one player.

review_questions: Are format and pick order complete enough to understand the draft?
Are alternatives and decision logic preserved for substantive choices?
Are market behavior, team need and source board separated?
Does the extraction include later-round observations and conclusions?
forbidden_distortions: Do not interpret picks without preserving format context.
Do not present a team-need selection as the source's universal ranking.
Do not omit later picks that materially inform strategy.
Do not invent alternatives that were never discussed.
extension_signals: A new draft format needs additional context.
A recurring draft decision factor is missing.
The source uses auction, salary-cap or keeper mechanics not represented.
A draft segment should become a Golden Set reference.
